actual_findings: Both right-door leaves have a coherent, warm grey/olive estimated glass material. The v2 irregular photographic islands and cut-out boundaries are absent.
Real door-frame and handle geometry remain, and the complete glass leaves stay inside their frames.
The central original-image cursive plaque is unchanged and remains correctly oriented.
Previously corrected roof courses, dark upper wood windows and complete RTL plaque remain visible; this v3 change is limited to the right door.
limits: The glass colour, roughness and metallic approximation are explicitly estimated, not measured optical properties.
This native light rig does not reproduce the HTML sky/environment reflections; runtime glass appearance requires separate web acceptance.
Different source-photo lighting/shadows are not a reason to keep endlessly colour-fitting this native candidate.
Stone guardians, frieze carvings and parts of the railing remain evidence-based simplifications, not exact scans or photo-traced carving.
Absolute height and concealed rear details remain documented inference.
